affordability_frontier_entry_fields.cost_vector: object(cost-vector): 10 minimized section-10.4 axes (cash/access_difficulty/evidence_tier_rank/new_equipment/material_quantity/energy/labor_time/preprocessing/analytical/waste_disposal), each number|null (UNKNOWN); cash_floor number|null (an honest partial-basket LOWER BOUND when the exact cash is UNKNOWN, mutually exclusive with cash -- COST-VEC-01-coupled); hard_blockers array[str]; currency/unit str (must match for cash comparison); region str

provider_snapshot_fields.content_digest: str (sha256; deterministic over the fetched records -- the reproducibility anchor)
provider_snapshot_fields.fetched_at: str (ISO-8601 UTC wall-clock; provenance, NOT in result_digest)
provider_snapshot_fields.provider_ids: array[str] (the providers consulted in the live fetch)

ranked_route_summary_fields.process_requirements: array[object(per-step declared process facts)|null] (PROCESS-ADMIT-01: the evidence process admission is RE-DERIVED from on load, one entry per route step in order, null for an undeclared step; part of route identity)

response_fields.admissible_route_digests: array[str] (FITS returned candidates under requested process constraints; not bench validation)
response_fields.affordability_frontier: array[object(affordability-frontier-entry)] (section-10.4 Pareto frontier over the ranked routes; COST-VEC-01. Empty when no route carries affordability signal -- a known cost axis or a hard blocker)
response_fields.provider_snapshots: array[object(provider-snapshot)] (section-13.2 dated provenance of any LIVE provider fetch; SNAPSHOT-13.2. Empty on an offline/default run)
response_fields.search_space_status: str|null (section 8.3 no-route matrix: NO_ROUTE_IN_DECLARED_SPACE/INCOMPLETE_NO_ROUTE_OBSERVED/COMPLETE_CANDIDATE_SET/PARTIAL_CANDIDATE_SET; null when no route search ran)

search_receipt_view_fields.candidate_limit: int|null (null: no engine stops on a distinct emitted-candidate cap)
search_receipt_view_fields.max_depth: int|null (null for the formula descent -- no depth bound)
